title: AI accelerated developers but not development: study of 500+ teams
summary: On 2026-09-05, a large-scale study of 500+ engineering teams found that while AI tools generate over half of code and save developers several hours weekly, companies are increasing AI budgets, but pull requests are becoming larger, code reviews are slowing, confidence in changes decreases, and saved time does not proportionally translate to new development.
